"""C143766 pedestrian Native entrypoint. --check never imports CARLA."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path

from corridor_construction import validate_scene
from corridor_map import verify_candidate_map
from native_capture import FourVideoRecorder, sample_original_walker
from native_driver import apply_walker_request, spawn_walker

FRAMES = 435


def write(path, value):
    Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, allow_nan=False)+"\n")


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def check_scene(scene_path, map_path):
    scene = json.loads(Path(scene_path).read_text())
    validate_scene(scene)
    verified = verify_candidate_map(map_path)
    if scene["map_source_sha256"] != verified["map_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("scene does not bind exact authored OpenDRIVE")
    return scene


def _trace(actor, sample):
    pose = actor.get_transform()
    velocity = actor.get_velocity()
    control = actor.get_control()
    components = [float(v) for v in (pose.location.x, pose.location.y, pose.location.z,
                                     pose.rotation.yaw, velocity.x, velocity.y, velocity.z,
                                     control.direction.x, control.direction.y,
                                     control.direction.z, control.speed)]
    if not all(math.isfinite(value) for value in components):
        raise ValueError("nonfinite original walker telemetry")
    x, y, z, yaw, vx, vy, vz, dx, dy, dz, speed = components
    return {"frame": sample["frame"], "time_s": sample["time_s"],
            "actor_id": sample["actor_id"], "position_m": [x, y, z],
            "position": {"x": x, "y": y, "z": z},
            "heading_deg": yaw, "velocity_mps": [vx, vy, vz],
            "speed_mps": math.sqrt(vx*vx+vy*vy+vz*vz),
            "speed_mph": math.sqrt(vx*vx+vy*vy+vz*vz)/.44704,
            "control": {},
            "walker_control": {"direction_xyz": [dx, dy, dz],
                               "requested_speed_mps": speed,
                               "jump": bool(control.jump)}}


def run_native(scene, scene_path, map_path, output, host, port):
    """Capture one fresh attempt against a caller-owned CARLA endpoint."""
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
    safe_root = (root/".runtime-work").resolve()
    output = Path(output).resolve()
    if not output.is_dir() or not output.is_relative_to(safe_root):
        raise ValueError("fresh attempt must be an existing directory under .runtime-work")
    if Path(scene_path).resolve() != output/"scene.json":
        raise ValueError("Native scene must be materialized in the exact attempt")
    if Path(map_path).resolve() != output/"candidate-corridor.xodr":
        raise ValueError("Native map must be materialized in the exact attempt")
    if not (output/"construction.json").is_file() or not (output/"runner.py").is_file():
        raise ValueError("runtime materialized construction and runner required")
    if any((output/name).exists() for name in ("trace.jsonl", "video_frames.jsonl",
                                              "walker-body-history.jsonl", "capture-seal.json")):
        raise ValueError("original acquisition already exists in attempt")
    os.environ["SCENARIO_PIPELINE_OUTPUT_ROOT"] = str(safe_root/"c143766-native-runtime")
    import carla
    from worker_exchange.native_output import FrameMap, seal_capture
    from worker_exchange.world_restore import snapshot as snapshot_world, restore
    from walker_pipeline_capture import WalkerPipelineCapture

    client = carla.Client(host, port)
    client.set_timeout(30)
    previous = snapshot_world(client)
    world = None
    actor = None
    videos = None
    capture = None
    frame_map = None
    captured = []
    cleanup = []
    error = None
    restoration = {"restored": False}
    try:
        source = Path(map_path)
        if sha(source) != scene["map_source_sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("authored OpenDRIVE bytes changed before Native loading")
        world = client.generate_opendrive_world(source.read_text())
        settings = world.get_settings()
        settings.synchronous_mode = True
        settings.fixed_delta_seconds = .05
        settings.no_rendering_mode = False
        world.apply_settings(settings)
        actor = spawn_walker(world, scene, carla)
        write(output/"acquisition-provenance.json", {
            "provenance_kind": "native", "diagnostic_fixture": False,
            "method": "original CARLA walker world vertices and four synchronized RGB sensors",
            "authored_road_sha256": sha(source), "case_id": scene["case_id"]})
        videos = FourVideoRecorder(world, scene, carla, output)
        capture = WalkerPipelineCapture(client, actor, output, scene["case_id"])
        frame_map = FrameMap(output/"video_frames.jsonl")
        target_index = 1
        with (output/"walker-body-history.jsonl").open("x", buffering=1) as body, \
             (output/"camera-frame-joins.jsonl").open("x", buffering=1) as joins:
            for _ in range(FRAMES):
                request = apply_walker_request(actor, carla, scene, target_index)
                target_index = request["target_index"]
                frame = world.tick()
                snap = world.get_snapshot()
                if frame != snap.frame:
                    raise RuntimeError("Native world tick/snapshot frame mismatch")
                sample = sample_original_walker(scene, actor, snap)
                join = videos.append(sample)
                captured_trace = capture.capture(frame, sample["time_s"], sample)
                if captured_trace["frame"] != frame:
                    raise RuntimeError("canonical walker graph and body frame mismatch")
                frame_map.append(frame, sample["time_s"])
                body.write(json.dumps(sample, allow_nan=False)+"\n")
                joins.write(json.dumps(join, allow_nan=False)+"\n")
                captured.append(frame)
    except BaseException as exc:
        error = repr(exc)
    finally:
        for resource in (frame_map, capture, videos):
            if resource is not None:
                try:
                    if resource is capture:
                        resource.close(confirmed=error is None)
                    else:
                        resource.close()
                except BaseException as exc: cleanup.append(repr(exc))
        if actor is not None:
            try: actor.destroy()
            except BaseException as exc: cleanup.append(repr(exc))
        try: restoration = restore(client, previous)
        except BaseException as exc: cleanup.append("world restoration: "+repr(exc))
    if error or cleanup or not restoration.get("restored"):
        write(output/"native-run-status.json", {"phase": "failed",
             "errors": [value for value in [error, *cleanup] if value],
             "restoration": restoration, "captured_frames": len(captured)})
        raise RuntimeError("Native pedestrian acquisition or restoration failed")
    sources = ("scene.json", "candidate-corridor.xodr", "road.xodr", "trace.jsonl",
               "walker-body-history.jsonl", "video_frames.jsonl", "camera-frame-joins.jsonl",
               *(name+".mkv" for name in ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")))
    write(output/"acquisition.json", {name: {"kind": "original_native",
          "sha256": sha(output/name)} for name in sources})
    seal_capture(output, frames=len(captured), restoration=restoration,
                 errors=[], encoder_exit_codes={name: 0 for name in
                 ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")},
                 context={"case_id": scene["case_id"],
                          "authored_road_sha256": scene["map_source_sha256"]})
    return {"case_id": scene["case_id"], "frames": len(captured),
            "native_acquisition_sealed": True, "physical_acceptance_claimed": False}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--scene", default="scene.json")
    parser.add_argument("--map", default="candidate-corridor.xodr")
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir")
    parser.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=2000)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    scene = check_scene(args.scene, args.map)
    if args.check:
        print(json.dumps({"case_id": scene["case_id"], "static_construction_valid": True,
                          "planned_frames": FRAMES, "native_started": False}))
    elif args.output_dir:
        print(json.dumps(run_native(scene, args.scene, args.map, args.output_dir,
                                    args.host, args.port)))
    else:
        parser.error("use --check or --output-dir")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Lazy CARLA-facing walker request for the authored corridor candidate."""
from __future__ import annotations

import math
import hashlib

from corridor_construction import request_next_target, validate_scene

LANE_IDS = {"roadway": -1, "shoulder": -2, "sidewalk": -3}


def bind_map(world_map, scene, location_factory, lane_type_any):
    """Reject an unreviewed map or wrong lane before a walker is spawned."""
    validate_scene(scene)
    if hashlib.sha256(world_map.to_opendrive().encode()).hexdigest() != scene["map_source_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("live OpenDRIVE source differs from authored candidate")
    waypoints = []
    for x, y in scene["pedestrian_route_xy_m"]:
        waypoint = world_map.get_waypoint(location_factory(x, y),
                                          project_to_road=False, lane_type=lane_type_any)
        if waypoint is None:
            raise ValueError("pedestrian route point has no Native waypoint")
        if waypoint.road_id != 1 or waypoint.lane_id != LANE_IDS[scene["route_band"]]:
            raise ValueError("pedestrian route point maps to wrong roadway or lane band")
        location = waypoint.transform.location
        if math.hypot(location.x-x, location.y-y) > .5:
            raise ValueError("pedestrian route point is too far from Native waypoint")
        waypoints.append(waypoint)
    return waypoints


def spawn_walker(world, scene, carla):
    """Spawn the exact pedestrian actor only after all map anchors bind."""
    waypoints = bind_map(world.get_map(), scene,
                         lambda x, y: carla.Location(x=x, y=y, z=.1), carla.LaneType.Any)
    blueprints = world.get_blueprint_library().filter("walker.pedestrian.*")
    if not blueprints:
        raise ValueError("No Native pedestrian blueprint")
    actor = world.spawn_actor(blueprints[0], waypoints[0].transform)
    if actor is None:
        raise ValueError("Native pedestrian spawn failed")
    return actor


def apply_walker_request(actor, carla, scene, target_index=1):
    """Send a next-tick request based on the original current walker pose."""
    validate_scene(scene)
    pose = actor.get_transform()
    x, y = float(pose.location.x), float(pose.location.y)
    if not math.isfinite(x) or not math.isfinite(y):
        raise ValueError("missing original walker pose")
    request = request_next_target(scene, x, y, target_index)
    dx, dy = request["direction_xy"]
    actor.apply_control(carla.WalkerControl(
        direction=carla.Vector3D(x=dx, y=dy, z=0), speed=request["speed_mps"], jump=False))
    return request

"""Walker telemetry adapter for the pinned original scene graph capture.

PipelineCapture owns the native recorder, map facts, graph collector and trace.
This override records WalkerControl explicitly instead of reading vehicle-only
throttle, brake and gear fields from a pedestrian actor.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import math
import time

from pipeline_capture import PipelineCapture, xyz


class WalkerPipelineCapture(PipelineCapture):
    def capture(self, frame, time_s, walker_sample):
        if self.closed or self.world.get_snapshot().frame != frame:
            raise RuntimeError("walker graph capture must observe the current original frame")
        if walker_sample["frame"] != frame or abs(walker_sample["time_s"]-time_s) > 1e-6:
            raise ValueError("walker body and graph frame identity differ")
        transform = self.ego.get_transform()
        velocity = self.ego.get_velocity()
        control = self.ego.get_control()
        speed = math.sqrt(velocity.x**2+velocity.y**2+velocity.z**2)
        position = xyz(transform.location)
        walker_control = {"direction_xyz": xyz(control.direction),
                          "requested_speed_mps": float(control.speed),
                          "jump": bool(control.jump)}
        row = {"frame": frame, "time_s": time_s,
               "actor_id": walker_sample["actor_id"],
               "position": dict(zip(("x", "y", "z"), position)),
               "position_m": position, "heading_deg": transform.rotation.yaw,
               "speed_mps": speed, "speed_mph": speed/.44704,
               "velocity_mps": xyz(velocity), "control": {},
               "walker_control": walker_control}
        from original_observations import observe
        started = time.perf_counter()
        observations = observe(self.world, self.ego, frame, time_s,
                               self.user_visibility, self.physical_registry)
        observations["map_context"] = self.map_context
        subject = next((item for item in observations["participants"]
                        if item["actor_id"] == self.ego.id), None)
        if subject is None:
            raise RuntimeError("original participant inventory omits walker")
        for key in ("accel_longitudinal_mps2", "acceleration_method",
                    "acceleration_projection", "acceleration_mps2",
                    "forward_vector"):
            if key in subject:
                row[key] = subject[key]
        observation_seconds = time.perf_counter()-started
        graph = self.collector.capture(frame, None, observed_evidence=observations)
        if not graph:
            raise RuntimeError("missing original walker adapter graph frame")
        waypoint = self.map.get_waypoint(transform.location)
        weather = self.world.get_weather()
        event = {"original_frame": frame, "replay_frame": frame,
                 "actor_id": self.ego.id, "recording_time_s": time_s,
                 "replay_simulation_time_s": graph["simulation_time"],
                 "ego": {"position_m": position,
                         "heading_deg": transform.rotation.yaw,
                         "speed_mps": speed,
                         "speed_provenance": "original_trace_actor_get_velocity",
                         "body_vertices_m": [xyz(vertex) for vertex in
                             self.ego.bounding_box.get_world_vertices(transform)]},
                 "world": {"weather": {key: getattr(weather, key) for key in
                     ("cloudiness", "precipitation", "precipitation_deposits",
                      "fog_density", "fog_distance", "sun_altitude_angle", "wetness")},
                     "road_projection": None if waypoint is None else {
                         "road_id": waypoint.road_id,
                         "section_id": waypoint.section_id,
                         "lane_id": waypoint.lane_id, "s_m": waypoint.s}},
                 "original_observations": observations,
                 "timing": {"observation_seconds": observation_seconds,
                            "graph_capture_seconds": graph.get("capture_seconds"),
                            "graph_extraction_seconds": graph.get("extraction_seconds")},
                 "supporting_only": {"applied_walker_control": walker_control}}
        self.trace.write(json.dumps(row, allow_nan=False)+"\n")
        self.evidence.write(json.dumps(event, allow_nan=False)+"\n")
        self.meta["frames"] += 1
        return row

"""Candidate OpenDRIVE bands for roadway, shoulder, sidewalk and trail.

The outer biking lane is an engineering trail stand-in. Its legal access and
municipal sidewalk purpose require independent reviewed sources.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import math
from pathlib import Path
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

BANDS = {
    "roadway": (0.0, 3.0),
    "shoulder": (3.0, 4.0),
    "sidewalk": (4.0, 6.0),
    "buffer": (6.0, 7.0),
    "nonmotorized_trail": (7.0, 9.0),
}
LANES = [(-1, "driving", 3.0), (-2, "shoulder", 1.0),
         (-3, "sidewalk", 2.0), (-4, "border", 1.0),
         (-5, "biking", 2.0)]


def map_bytes():
    root = ET.Element("OpenDRIVE")
    ET.SubElement(root, "header", revMajor="1", revMinor="4",
                  name="C143766 engineering pedestrian corridor", version="1",
                  north="10", south="-1", east="30", west="0",
                  vendor="worker-candidate")
    road = ET.SubElement(root, "road", name="candidate corridor", length="30", id="1", junction="-1")
    ET.SubElement(road, "link")
    view = ET.SubElement(road, "planView")
    geometry = ET.SubElement(view, "geometry", s="0", x="30", y="0",
                             hdg=str(math.pi), length="30")
    ET.SubElement(geometry, "line")
    elevation = ET.SubElement(road, "elevationProfile")
    ET.SubElement(elevation, "elevation", s="0", a="0", b="0", c="0", d="0")
    ET.SubElement(road, "lateralProfile")
    lanes = ET.SubElement(road, "lanes")
    section = ET.SubElement(lanes, "laneSection", s="0")
    center = ET.SubElement(section, "center")
    ET.SubElement(center, "lane", id="0", type="none", level="false")
    right = ET.SubElement(section, "right")
    for lane_id, kind, width in LANES:
        lane = ET.SubElement(right, "lane", id=str(lane_id), type=kind, level="false")
        ET.SubElement(lane, "width", sOffset="0", a=str(width), b="0", c="0", d="0")
    return ET.tostring(root, encoding="utf-8", xml_declaration=True) + b"\n"


def map_sha256():
    return hashlib.sha256(map_bytes()).hexdigest()


def verify_candidate_map(path):
    data = Path(path).read_bytes()
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != map_sha256():
        raise ValueError("candidate OpenDRIVE source bytes changed")
    root = ET.fromstring(data)
    roads = root.findall("road")
    if len(roads) != 1 or roads[0].get("id") != "1":
        raise ValueError("candidate corridor road identity changed")
    geometry = roads[0].find("./planView/geometry")
    if geometry is None or geometry.find("line") is None:
        raise ValueError("candidate corridor has no line geometry")
    if (float(geometry.get("x")) != 30 or float(geometry.get("y")) != 0 or
            abs(float(geometry.get("hdg"))-math.pi) > 1e-9 or
            float(geometry.get("length")) != 30):
        raise ValueError("candidate corridor coordinate frame changed")
    lanes = roads[0].findall("./lanes/laneSection/right/lane")
    observed = [(int(lane.get("id")), lane.get("type"),
                 float(lane.find("width").get("a"))) for lane in lanes]
    if observed != LANES:
        raise ValueError("candidate corridor lane types or widths changed")
    if sum(width for _, _, width in LANES) != BANDS["nonmotorized_trail"][1]:
        raise ValueError("candidate corridor band offsets changed")
    return {"map_sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
            "lane_types": [kind for _, kind, _ in observed],
            "lane_centers_y_m": [1.5, 3.5, 5.0, 6.5, 8.0],
            "limitations": "Engineering OpenDRIVE only; CARLA import and legal sidewalk/trail purpose unverified."}

"""Recompute corridor measurements from retained original pedestrian bodies."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from corridor_construction import measure_original
from corridor_map import verify_candidate_map


def _verified(root, entry):
    path = (root / entry["path"]).resolve()
    if not path.is_relative_to(root.resolve()) or not path.is_file():
        raise ValueError("Missing required source: " + entry["path"])
    data = path.read_bytes()
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != entry["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("Original source hash differs: " + entry["path"])
    return data


def measure_saved(root, manifest_path):
    root = Path(root)
    manifest = json.loads(Path(manifest_path).read_text())
    if manifest.get("format") != "c143766-original-pedestrian-sources-v1":
        raise ValueError("unknown original source manifest")
    scene = json.loads(_verified(root, manifest["scene"]))
    map_entry = manifest["map"]
    _verified(root, map_entry)
    map_path = (root / map_entry["path"]).resolve()
    verified_map = verify_candidate_map(map_path)
    if scene["map_source_sha256"] != verified_map["map_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("scene and original OpenDRIVE source differ")
    data = _verified(root, manifest["body_history"])
    try:
        frames = [json.loads(line) for line in data.decode().splitlines() if line]
    except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        raise ValueError("Original body history is not valid JSONL") from exc
    if any(frame.get("case_id") != scene["case_id"] for frame in frames):
        raise ValueError("Original body history case identity differs")
    measured = measure_original(scene, frames)
    return {"case_id": scene["case_id"], "measurement": measured,
            "scene_sha256": manifest["scene"]["sha256"],
            "map_sha256": verified_map["map_sha256"],
            "body_history_sha256": manifest["body_history"]["sha256"],
            "original_source_verified": True,
            "legal_judgment": "unresolved", "physical_acceptance_claimed": False}

"""Independent saved-source integrity audit for C143766 pedestrian attempts.

This verifies original identity, sealed bytes and body motion. Full video decode,
actual pixel visibility, legal context and acceptance are separate later gates.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys

from corridor_construction import measure_original, validate_scene
from native_capture import CAMERA_SPECS


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def rows(path):
    return [json.loads(line) for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]


def _source(root, name, expected):
    path = (root/name).resolve()
    if not path.is_relative_to(root) or not path.is_file():
        raise ValueError("missing sealed original source: "+name)
    if sha(path) != expected:
        raise ValueError("sealed original source hash differs: "+name)
    return path


def verify_frame_joins(scene, mapping, bodies, trace, joins, *, diagnostic_test=False):
    """Cross-check every retained Native identity without trusting case labels."""
    count = len(mapping)
    if count < 3 or not all(len(group) == count for group in (bodies, trace, joins)):
        raise ValueError("original frame sources have missing rows")
    first = mapping[0]["carla_frame"]
    actor_id = bodies[0].get("actor_id", 7) if diagnostic_test else bodies[0]["actor_id"]
    for index, (frame_map, body, observation, joined) in enumerate(
            zip(mapping, bodies, trace, joins)):
        frame = first+index
        time_s = frame_map["time_s"]
        if (frame_map.get("video_frame") != index or
                frame_map.get("carla_frame") != frame or
                frame_map.get("native_frame") != frame or
                not isinstance(time_s, (int, float)) or not math.isfinite(time_s)):
            raise ValueError("original frame map is not consecutive")
        if index and abs(time_s-mapping[index-1]["time_s"]-.05) > .005:
            raise ValueError("original frame map timing is not 20 Hz")
        if (body.get("case_id") != scene["case_id"] or
                (not diagnostic_test and body.get("source_kind") != "original_native_world_vertices") or
                body.get("actor_id", 7) != actor_id or body.get("frame") != frame or
                abs(body.get("time_s", float("inf"))-time_s) > 1e-4):
            raise ValueError("original walker body identity or timestamp differs")
        if (observation.get("actor_id", 7) != actor_id or
                observation.get("frame") != frame or
                abs(observation.get("time_s", float("inf"))-time_s) > 1e-4):
            raise ValueError("original trace identity or timestamp differs")
        center = observation.get("position_m")
        if (not isinstance(center, list) or len(center) != 3 or
                not all(isinstance(v, (int, float)) and math.isfinite(v) for v in center)):
            raise ValueError("original trace lacks finite walker position")
        footprint = body.get("body_xy_m", [])
        if (len(footprint) != 4 or
                any(len(point) != 2 for point in footprint) or
                not all(min(point[axis] for point in footprint) <= center[axis] <=
                        max(point[axis] for point in footprint) for axis in (0, 1))):
            raise ValueError("original trace walker position leaves body footprint")
        if (joined.get("case_id") != scene["case_id"] or
                joined.get("walker_actor_id", 7) != actor_id or
                joined.get("frame") != frame or
                abs(joined.get("time_s", float("inf"))-time_s) > 1e-4 or
                set(joined.get("cameras", {})) != set(CAMERA_SPECS)):
            raise ValueError("original four-camera join identity differs")
        for name, (width, height) in CAMERA_SPECS.items():
            camera = joined["cameras"][name]
            if (camera.get("frame") != frame or camera.get("width") != width or
                    camera.get("height") != height or
                    camera.get("pixel_format") != "bgra" or
                    camera.get("bytes") != width*height*4):
                raise ValueError("original camera source metadata differs: "+name)
    measured = measure_original(scene, bodies)
    return {"frame_count": count, "walker_actor_id": actor_id,
            "motion_measurement": measured, "time_join_passed": True,
            "four_camera_metadata_join_passed": True,
            "physical_acceptance_claimed": False}


def verify_saved_sources(attempt):
    """Reopen and verify every original source listed in the pinned capture seal."""
    root = Path(attempt).resolve()
    seal = json.loads((root/"capture-seal.json").read_text())
    provenance = json.loads((root/"acquisition-provenance.json").read_text())
    if (seal.get("format") != "worker-sealed-capture" or
            seal.get("provenance_kind") != "native" or seal.get("diagnostic_fixture") or
            provenance.get("provenance_kind") != "native" or
            provenance.get("diagnostic_fixture") is not False or
            seal.get("restoration", {}).get("restored") is not True or
            seal.get("encoder_exit_codes") != {name: 0 for name in CAMERA_SPECS}):
        raise ValueError("sealed Native acquisition and restoration required")
    sources = seal.get("sources")
    if not isinstance(sources, dict) or not sources:
        raise ValueError("sealed source inventory missing")
    digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(sources, sort_keys=True,
                            separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()
    if digest != seal.get("source_digest"):
        raise ValueError("sealed source inventory digest differs")
    for name, expected in sources.items():
        _source(root, name, expected)
    required = {"scene.json", "candidate-corridor.xodr", "trace.jsonl",
                "walker-body-history.jsonl", "video_frames.jsonl",
                "camera-frame-joins.jsonl", "acquisition.json",
                *(name+".mkv" for name in CAMERA_SPECS)}
    if not required <= set(sources):
        raise ValueError("sealed original source inventory is incomplete")
    scene = json.loads((root/"scene.json").read_text())
    validate_scene(scene)
    if sha(root/"candidate-corridor.xodr") != scene["map_source_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("sealed scene and authored map differ")
    acquisition = json.loads((root/"acquisition.json").read_text())
    if set(acquisition) != (required-{"acquisition.json"}) | {"road.xodr"}:
        raise ValueError("original acquisition inventory differs")
    for name, item in acquisition.items():
        if item.get("kind") != "original_native" or item.get("sha256") != sha(root/name):
            raise ValueError("original acquisition source differs: "+name)
    result = verify_frame_joins(scene, rows(root/"video_frames.jsonl"),
                                rows(root/"walker-body-history.jsonl"),
                                rows(root/"trace.jsonl"),
                                rows(root/"camera-frame-joins.jsonl"))
    if result["frame_count"] != seal.get("frames"):
        raise ValueError("sealed frame count differs")
    result.update({"format": "c143766-saved-original-source-audit-v1",
                   "case_id": scene["case_id"],
                   "capture_seal_sha256": sha(root/"capture-seal.json"),
                   "source_digest": digest,
                   "original_source_integrity_passed": True,
                   "full_video_decode_passed": False,
                   "actual_pixel_visibility_verified": False,
                   "legal_judgment": "unresolved"})
    return result


def verify_diagnostic_sources(attempt):
    """Check a marked software fixture without treating it as Native evidence."""
    root = Path(attempt).resolve()
    seal = json.loads((root/"capture-seal.json").read_text())
    provenance = json.loads((root/"acquisition-provenance.json").read_text())
    if (seal.get("format") != "worker-sealed-capture" or
            seal.get("provenance_kind") != "synthetic_fixture" or
            seal.get("diagnostic_fixture") is not True or
            seal.get("restoration", {}).get("restored") is not True or
            provenance.get("provenance_kind") != "synthetic_fixture" or
            provenance.get("diagnostic_fixture") is not True):
        raise ValueError("diagnostic fixture provenance required")
    sources = seal.get("sources", {})
    digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(sources, sort_keys=True,
                            separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()
    if digest != seal.get("source_digest"):
        raise ValueError("diagnostic source inventory digest differs")
    required = {"scene.json", "candidate-corridor.xodr", "trace.jsonl",
                "walker-body-history.jsonl", "video_frames.jsonl",
                "camera-frame-joins.jsonl", "analysis-report.json", "result.json",
                *(name+".mkv" for name in CAMERA_SPECS)}
    if not required <= set(sources):
        raise ValueError("diagnostic source inventory incomplete")
    for name, expected in sources.items():
        _source(root, name, expected)
    scene = json.loads((root/"scene.json").read_text())
    validate_scene(scene)
    if sha(root/"candidate-corridor.xodr") != scene["map_source_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("diagnostic scene and map differ")
    result = verify_frame_joins(scene, rows(root/"video_frames.jsonl"),
                                rows(root/"walker-body-history.jsonl"),
                                rows(root/"trace.jsonl"),
                                rows(root/"camera-frame-joins.jsonl"),
                                diagnostic_test=True)
    if result["frame_count"] != seal.get("frames"):
        raise ValueError("diagnostic frame count differs")
    result.update({"format": "c143766-diagnostic-source-audit-v1",
                   "case_id": scene["case_id"],
                   "capture_seal_sha256": sha(root/"capture-seal.json"),
                   "source_digest": digest,
                   "original_source_integrity_passed": True,
                   "full_video_decode_passed": False,
                   "actual_pixel_visibility_verified": False,
                   "legal_judgment": "unresolved"})
    return result


def decode_original_videos(attempt, *, diagnostic_test=False):
    """Run pinned complete decodes after source sealing, retaining exact receipts."""
    source_check = (verify_diagnostic_sources(attempt) if diagnostic_test else
                    verify_saved_sources(attempt))
    root = Path(attempt).resolve()
    repository = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
    safe_root = (repository/".runtime-work").resolve()
    if not root.is_relative_to(safe_root):
        raise ValueError("original video decode requires .runtime-work attempt")
    os.environ["SCENARIO_PIPELINE_OUTPUT_ROOT"] = str(safe_root/"c143766-audit-runtime")
    runtime_pipeline = repository/"runtime/scenario_pipeline"
    if str(runtime_pipeline) not in sys.path:
        sys.path.insert(0, str(runtime_pipeline))
    from worker_exchange.media import audit, check_four_view_sources

    videos = {name: root/(name+".mkv") for name in CAMERA_SPECS}
    check_four_view_sources(videos)
    mapping_sha = sha(root/"video_frames.jsonl")
    receipt_dir = safe_root/"c143766-audit-receipts"/sha(root/"capture-seal.json")
    receipt_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    decoded = {}
    for name, (width, height) in CAMERA_SPECS.items():
        receipt_path = receipt_dir/("source-decode-"+name+".json")
        receipt = audit(videos[name], source_check["frame_count"],
                        mapping_sha256=mapping_sha, receipt=receipt_path)
        if receipt.get("dimensions") != [width, height]:
            raise ValueError("decoded camera dimensions differ: "+name)
        decoded[name] = {"video_sha256": receipt["video_sha256"],
                         "receipt_sha256": sha(receipt_path),
                         "decoded_frames": receipt["frames"]}
    return {**source_check, "full_video_decode_passed": True,
            "source_decode_receipts": decoded,
            "actual_pixel_visibility_verified": False,
            "physical_acceptance_claimed": False}


def audit(attempt, *, diagnostic_test=False):
    """Cross-check sealed sources, decoded media and saved physical status."""
    root = Path(attempt).resolve()
    decoded = decode_original_videos(root, diagnostic_test=diagnostic_test)
    report = json.loads((root/"analysis-report.json").read_text())
    result = json.loads((root/"result.json").read_text())
    measured = decoded["motion_measurement"]
    selected = report.get("measurements", {}).get("pedestrian_full_body_band_occupancy", {})
    if (report.get("case_id") != decoded["case_id"] or
            result.get("case_id") != decoded["case_id"] or
            selected.get("value") != measured or
            result.get("measured_values") != measured):
        raise ValueError("saved original measurement differs from independent body audit")
    checks = result.get("physical_checks", {})
    maneuver = checks.get("maneuver", {})
    if (maneuver.get("status") not in ("met", "not_met", "unverified") or
            result.get("maneuver_completed") != (maneuver["status"] == "met") or
            not result.get("target_checks") or
            result["target_checks"][0].get("measured") != measured["all_body_inside_route_band"]):
        raise ValueError("saved physical completion or body target differs")
    if diagnostic_test and (result.get("provenance_kind") != "synthetic_fixture" or
                            result.get("diagnostic_fixture") is not True):
        raise ValueError("diagnostic result provenance differs")
    return {**decoded, "format": "worker-delivery-audit",
            "diagnostic_audit_test_passed": diagnostic_test,
            "physical_completion_status": maneuver["status"],
            "actual_pixels_fully_decoded": True,
            "actual_pixel_visibility_verified": False,
            "legal_verdict_claimed": False,
            "physical_acceptance_claimed": False}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--attempt", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(audit(args.attempt), indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Independent source-bound audit of diagnostic pedestrian route pairs."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path

from corridor_construction import compare_authored_routes
from saved_measurement import _verified, measure_saved
from delivery_audit import audit as audit_delivery, rows as delivery_rows, sha


def audit_pair(root, first_manifest, second_manifest, *, declared_band_change):
    root = Path(root)
    manifests = [json.loads(Path(path).read_text()) for path in (first_manifest, second_manifest)]
    scenes = [json.loads(_verified(root, item["scene"])) for item in manifests]
    authored = compare_authored_routes(scenes[0], scenes[1], declared_band_change)
    saved = [measure_saved(root, path) for path in (first_manifest, second_manifest)]
    if saved[0]["map_sha256"] != saved[1]["map_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("comparison map source changed")
    histories = [[json.loads(line) for line in _verified(root, item["body_history"]).decode().splitlines() if line]
                 for item in manifests]
    if len(histories[0]) != len(histories[1]):
        raise ValueError("comparison frame counts differ")
    first, second = histories
    if [row["frame"] for row in first] != [row["frame"] for row in second]:
        raise ValueError("comparison frame identities differ")
    if [row["time_s"] for row in first] != [row["time_s"] for row in second]:
        raise ValueError("comparison frame times differ")
    for a, b in zip(first, second):
        xs1 = [point[0] for point in a["body_xy_m"]]
        xs2 = [point[0] for point in b["body_xy_m"]]
        if xs1 != xs2:
            raise ValueError("comparison longitudinal original bodies differ")
        ys1 = [point[1] for point in a["body_xy_m"]]
        ys2 = [point[1] for point in b["body_xy_m"]]
        delta = ys2[0] - ys1[0]
        if abs(delta) < .5 or any(abs((y2-y1)-delta) > 1e-9 for y1, y2 in zip(ys1, ys2)):
            raise ValueError("comparison lateral original bodies are not an isolated translation")
    bands = [scenes[0]["route_band"], scenes[1]["route_band"]]
    for item, band in zip(saved, bands):
        counts = item["measurement"]["band_overlap_frame_counts"]
        if counts[band] != item["measurement"]["frames"]:
            raise ValueError("original body does not traverse its authored band")
    return {"case_ids": [item["case_id"] for item in saved],
            "map_sha256": saved[0]["map_sha256"],
            "body_history_sha256": [item["body_history_sha256"] for item in saved],
            "authored": authored, "original_lateral_difference_measured": True,
            "physical_acceptance_claimed": False, "legal_judgment": "unresolved"}


def audit_delivery_pair(first_attempt, second_attempt, *, diagnostic_test=False):
    """Independently compare two sealed delivered attempts and their decoded media."""
    roots = [Path(first_attempt).resolve(), Path(second_attempt).resolve()]
    receipts = [audit_delivery(root, diagnostic_test=diagnostic_test) for root in roots]
    scenes = [json.loads((root/"scene.json").read_text()) for root in roots]
    authored = compare_authored_routes(scenes[0], scenes[1], True)
    if [receipt["case_id"] for receipt in receipts] != [scene["case_id"] for scene in scenes]:
        raise ValueError("paired delivery case identity differs")
    histories = [delivery_rows(root/"walker-body-history.jsonl") for root in roots]
    if len(histories[0]) != len(histories[1]):
        raise ValueError("paired original frame counts differ")
    if [(row["frame"], row["time_s"]) for row in histories[0]] != [
            (row["frame"], row["time_s"]) for row in histories[1]]:
        raise ValueError("paired original frame and time identities differ")
    for left, right in zip(*histories):
        x_left = [point[0] for point in left["body_xy_m"]]
        x_right = [point[0] for point in right["body_xy_m"]]
        if any(abs(a-b) > (.5 if not diagnostic_test else 1e-9)
               for a, b in zip(x_left, x_right)):
            raise ValueError("paired longitudinal original bodies differ")
        y_left = [point[1] for point in left["body_xy_m"]]
        y_right = [point[1] for point in right["body_xy_m"]]
        shift = y_right[0]-y_left[0]
        if abs(shift) < .5 or any(abs((b-a)-shift) > (.5 if not diagnostic_test else 1e-9)
                                    for a, b in zip(y_left, y_right)):
            raise ValueError("paired lateral body change is not isolated")
    if not diagnostic_test and any(receipt["physical_completion_status"] != "met"
                                   for receipt in receipts):
        raise ValueError("paired Native physical completion not established")
    return {"format": "c143766-paired-delivery-audit-v1",
            "case_ids": [scene["case_id"] for scene in scenes],
            "map_sha256": scenes[0]["map_source_sha256"],
            "body_history_sha256": [sha(root/"walker-body-history.jsonl") for root in roots],
            "capture_seal_sha256": [receipt["capture_seal_sha256"] for receipt in receipts],
            "authored": authored, "frame_count": len(histories[0]),
            "four_view_full_decode_passed": True,
            "diagnostic_audit_test_passed": diagnostic_test,
            "physical_acceptance_claimed": False,
            "actual_pixel_visibility_verified": False,
            "legal_judgment": "unresolved"}

"""Saved-only finalizer for the exact pedestrian corridor cases.

The engineering band measurement is independent of legal sidewalk purpose.
Synthetic fixture provenance remains explicit in every derived report.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

from corridor_construction import measure_original, validate_scene
from corridor_map import verify_candidate_map

CAMERAS = ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")
SOURCES = ("scene.json", "candidate-corridor.xodr", "trace.jsonl",
           "video_frames.jsonl", "walker-body-history.jsonl",
           "camera-frame-joins.jsonl")


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def rows(path):
    return [json.loads(line) for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines() if line]


def required(root, name):
    path = root/name
    if not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size == 0:
        raise ValueError("Missing required source: "+name)
    return path


def measure_original_corridor(scene, bodies):
    """Expose the executed, case-specific measurement contract method."""
    return measure_original(scene, bodies)


def build_report(attempt):
    root = Path(attempt).resolve()
    marker = json.loads(required(root, "acquisition-provenance.json").read_text())
    kind = marker.get("provenance_kind")
    fixture = marker.get("diagnostic_fixture")
    if (kind, fixture) not in (("native", False), ("synthetic_fixture", True)):
        raise ValueError("contradictory acquisition provenance")
    paths = {name: required(root, name) for name in SOURCES}
    for name in CAMERAS:
        paths[name+".mkv"] = required(root, name+".mkv")
    scene = json.loads(paths["scene.json"].read_text())
    validate_scene(scene)
    if verify_candidate_map(paths["candidate-corridor.xodr"])["map_sha256"] != scene["map_source_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("exact corridor map source differs")
    config = json.loads(required(root, "config.json").read_text())
    if config["selected_case_id"] != scene["case_id"]:
        raise ValueError("exact case differs from source scene")
    if kind == "native":
        seal = json.loads(required(root, "capture-seal.json").read_text())
        if seal.get("provenance_kind") != "native" or seal.get("diagnostic_fixture") is not False:
            raise ValueError("Native capture seal provenance differs")
        for name, digest in seal.get("sources", {}).items():
            if sha(required(root, name)) != digest:
                raise ValueError("sealed original source changed: "+name)
    mapping = rows(paths["video_frames.jsonl"])
    trace = rows(paths["trace.jsonl"])
    bodies = rows(paths["walker-body-history.jsonl"])
    joins = rows(paths["camera-frame-joins.jsonl"])
    count = len(mapping)
    if count < 5 or (kind == "native" and count != 435) or any(
            len(group) != count for group in (trace, bodies, joins)):
        raise ValueError("incomplete original frame groups")
    for index, group in enumerate(zip(mapping, trace, bodies, joins)):
        frame_map, telemetry, body, join = group
        frame = frame_map.get("carla_frame")
        time_s = frame_map.get("time_s")
        if frame_map.get("video_frame") != index or any(
            item.get("frame") != frame or abs(item.get("time_s", -1)-time_s) > 1e-6
            for item in (telemetry, body, join)):
            raise ValueError("original body, trace, video and camera frame join failed")
        if body.get("case_id") != scene["case_id"] or join.get("case_id") != scene["case_id"]:
            raise ValueError("original frame case identity differs")
        if set(join.get("cameras", {})) != set(CAMERAS) or any(
            join["cameras"][name].get("frame") != frame for name in CAMERAS):
            raise ValueError("four original camera frame joins missing")
    measured = measure_original_corridor(scene, bodies)
    measurement_sources = ("walker-body-history.jsonl", "trace.jsonl",
                           "video_frames.jsonl", "camera-frame-joins.jsonl")
    report = {"format": "worker-analysis-report", "analysis_complete": True,
              "case_id": scene["case_id"], "provenance_kind": kind,
              "diagnostic_fixture": fixture,
              "measurements": {"pedestrian_full_body_band_occupancy": {
                  "method": "measure_original_corridor", "value": measured,
                  "sources": {name: sha(paths[name]) for name in measurement_sources}}},
              "legal_verdict_claimed": False,
              "limitations": ["Authored lane geometry does not establish municipal sidewalk purpose or trail access.",
                              "A diagnostic fixture proves software joins only, not realized Native walking or pixels."]}
    return report, config, scene, bodies, trace


def saved_result(attempt, report, config, scene, bodies, trace):
    root = Path(attempt).resolve()
    safe = next((parent for parent in root.parents if parent.name == ".runtime-work"), None)
    if safe is None:
        raise ValueError("analysis attempt must be under .runtime-work")
    os.environ["SCENARIO_PIPELINE_OUTPUT_ROOT"] = str(safe.resolve())
    from worker_exchange.native_output import physical_result, validate_result

    description = config["case"]["recording_description"]
    construction = json.loads(required(root, "construction.json").read_text())
    if description != construction["recording_description"]:
        raise ValueError("recording description differs from exact construction")
    values = {
        "walker_body_xy_m": [(r["time_s"], r["body_xy_m"]) for r in bodies],
        "walker_route_progress": [(r["time_s"], r["position_m"]) for r in trace],
        "sidewalk_and_roadway_boundaries": [
            (r["time_s"], {name: scene["bounds_xy_m"][name]
                             for name in ("sidewalk", "shoulder", "roadway")})
            for r in bodies],
        "trail_access_and_purpose": [
            (r["time_s"], {"band_xy_m": scene["bounds_xy_m"]["nonmotorized_trail"],
                            "access_status": scene["trail_access_status"],
                            "sidewalk_provided_claim": scene["sidewalk_provided_claim"]})
            for r in bodies],
    }
    folder = root/"channels"
    folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    evidence = []
    for item in description["channels"]:
        name = item["name"]
        if name not in values:
            raise ValueError("unsupported recorded channel: "+name)
        path = folder/(name+".jsonl")
        with path.open("x") as stream:
            for time_s, value in values[name]:
                stream.write(json.dumps({"time_s": time_s, "value": value}, allow_nan=False)+"\n")
        evidence.append({"name": name, "unit": item["unit"],
                         "reference": str(path.relative_to(root))})
    context = {"sidewalk_roadway_shoulder_trail_context": {
        "authored_map_sha256": sha(root/"candidate-corridor.xodr"),
        "bands_xy_m": scene["bounds_xy_m"],
        "sidewalk_provided_claim": scene["sidewalk_provided_claim"],
        "trail_access_status": scene["trail_access_status"],
        "camera_sources_sha256": {name: sha(root/(name+".mkv")) for name in CAMERAS}}}
    context_path = folder/"context.json"
    context_path.write_text(json.dumps(context, allow_nan=False)+"\n")
    for item in description["context_inputs"]:
        evidence.append({"name": item["name"], "unit": item["unit"],
                         "reference": str(context_path.relative_to(root))})
    measurement = report["measurements"]["pedestrian_full_body_band_occupancy"]
    observed = measurement["value"]["all_body_inside_route_band"]
    target = {"target": "whole walker body in authored "+scene["route_band"]+" band",
              "requested": True, "measured": observed,
              "method": "original full-body polygon against source-hashed authored band",
              "tolerance": 0, "matched": observed is True,
              "physical_cause_confirmed": False,
              "cause_evidence": measurement["sources"]}
    result = {"case_id": scene["case_id"], "measured_values": measurement["value"],
              "target_checks": [target], "setup_confirmed": False,
              "behavior_attempted": False, "maneuver_completed": False,
              "termination_reason": "Saved source review pending physical assessment",
              "physical_failure_flags": [], "trace_reference": "trace.jsonl",
              "video_references": [name+".mkv" for name in CAMERAS],
              "video_frame_map_reference": "video_frames.jsonl",
              "recording_description": description, "recording_evidence": evidence,
              "realized_observables": {}}
    result = physical_result(root, result)
    validate_result(result)
    return result


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--attempt", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    report, config, scene, bodies, trace = build_report(args.attempt)
    result = saved_result(args.attempt, report, config, scene, bodies, trace)
    report["physical_checks"] = result["physical_checks"]
    report["realized_observables"] = result["realized_observables"]
    with (Path(args.attempt)/"result.json").open("x") as stream:
        stream.write(json.dumps(result, indent=2, allow_nan=False)+"\n")
    Path(args.output).write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, allow_nan=False)+"\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Materialized exact pedestrian construction checks, without CARLA."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import unittest

from native_capture import CAMERA_SPECS, camera_placements
from runner import FRAMES, check_scene


class OfflineConstructionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_exact_case_map_walker_and_four_camera_plan(self):
        root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
        scene = check_scene(root/"scene.json", root/"candidate-corridor.xodr")
        config = json.loads((root/"config.json").read_text())
        self.assertEqual(scene["case_id"], config["selected_case_id"])
        self.assertEqual(config["actor"], "pedestrian")
        self.assertEqual(config["rate_hz"], 20)
        self.assertEqual(round(config["duration_s"]*20), FRAMES)
        self.assertEqual([camera["name"] for camera in config["cameras"]], list(CAMERA_SPECS))
        self.assertEqual(set(camera_placements(scene)), set(CAMERA_SPECS))
        self.assertEqual(len(scene["pedestrian_route_xy_m"]), 3)
